jobs.description:
**Senior .NET Developer**


Bij Sogeti werk je als Senior .NET Developer in een omgeving waar technologie, vakmanschap en samenwerking centraal staan. Je maakt deel uit van multidisciplinaire DevOps‑ en platformteams en werkt aan complexe softwareoplossingen voor organisaties waar technologie direct bijdraagt aan groei, modernisering en continuïteit. Onze cultuur is informeel, met korte lijnen, veel ruimte voor initiatief en een sterke focus op kwaliteit.


Als strategische Microsoft‑partner met een sterke engineering‑focus investeren we actief in onze Microsoft Community. Je komt terecht in een community waarin kennisdeling, experimenteren en persoonlijke expertiseontwikkeling vanzelfsprekend zijn. Vanuit ons kantoor in Utrecht – en daarbuiten – organiseren we maandelijkse meet‑ups, deep dives en hands‑on sessies over onder andere .NET, Azure, GitHub, Developer Experience en AI‑gedreven development.


**Werken als Senior .NET Developer bij Sogeti**


Als Senior .NET Developer zet je je technische expertise in bij uitdagende projecten met zichtbare impact. Je werkt aan moderne .NET‑oplossingen met behulp van cloud‑native architecturen, microservices, API‑first designs en integraties met AI‑ en data‑gedreven componenten. Daarbij maak je bewuste, pragmatische keuzes die passen bij de schaal en ambities van de organisatie.


Je werkt met moderne tooling en platformen zoals Git, CI/CD‑pipelines, cloud‑platformen en containertechnologie (Docker/Kubernetes). Je bent een inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor klanten en collega’s en draagt actief bij aan het verbeteren van ontwikkelstandaarden, best practices en developer experience binnen projecten en teams.


Binnen onze Microsoft Community speel je als senior een zichtbare rol. Je deelt kennis, begeleidt collega’s en helpt richting te geven aan technische keuzes en nieuwe ontwikkelingen, zoals AI‑assisted development en moderne platform‑gedreven software engineering.


**Wie ben jij?**


* Je hebt een afgeronde hbo\- of wo\-opleiding en minimaal vijf jaar ervaring als .NET Developer.
* Je hebt diepgaande kennis van .NET Framework/Core, C\#, Azure (App Services, Functions), REST API’s en moderne frontend‑ of integratiepatronen.
* Je hebt ervaring met softwarearchitectuur, DevOps, CI/CD en bij voorkeur ook containertechnologie.
* Je hebt of wilt één of meerdere relevante Microsoft‑certificeringen behalen, zoals Azure Developer Associate (AZ‑204\), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ‑400\) of Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI‑102\).
* Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal op minimaal C1\-niveau.

**Dit bieden wij jou**


* Een dienstverband van 40 uur per week, met flexibele mogelijkheden om parttime te werken.


* Een startsalaris tussen de € 55\.000 en € 85\.000 bruto per jaar (dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsbudget), plus bonus.


* Een flexibel mobiliteitsbudget, met o.a. opties om elektrisch te rijden.


* Hybride werken en een goede werk\-privébalans.


* Uitgebreide opleidings\- en certificeringsmogelijkheden.


* 26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de optie om extra dagen bij te kopen.


* Uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties waarin jouw technische expertise het verschil maakt.


**Ben jij nieuwsgierig geworden naar de projecten waar wij dagelijks aan werken en wil jij deel uitmaken van onze actieve Microsoft Community?**


Solliciteer nu en ontdek hoe jij het verschil kunt maken!


Een PES\-screening en assessment maken deel uit van het proces.


Heb je nog vragen over de vacature?
  

Jouw recruiter, Harold Los, beantwoordt ze graag. App of mail gerust.

jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For these roles, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations and you'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in the office \- Perth, Glasgow, Inverness or Aberdeen.


**Salary:** £36,200 \- £80,000 \+ car/car allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.



Opportunities are available at the following levels, depending on skills and experience:


* **Assistant Engineer:** £36,200 \- £54,400
* **Engineer:** £51,600 \- £77,400
* **Senior Engineer:** £59,800 \- £80,000


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Fixed Term Contract \| Full Time \| Part Time \| Flexible First options available


**The roles**



SSEN Transmission has exciting opportunities for Assistant Cable Engineers, Cable Engineers and Senior Cable Engineers to join our growing engineering teams.



Whether you're at the beginning of your engineering journey or already an experienced engineer looking for your next challenge, you'll have the opportunity to help deliver the infrastructure that will enable the UK's transition to net zero.



As SSEN Transmission invests billions to upgrade the network and connect renewable generation across the UK, you'll work on some of the country's largest and most ambitious transmission and substation projects, helping to deliver a cleaner, more secure energy future.



Working across a diverse portfolio of transmission and substation projects operating at voltages up to 400kV, you'll contribute to the development and delivery of innovative engineering solutions that will power communities for generations to come.


**You will**


* Provide cable engineering support across multiple projects by producing or reviewing outline cable system designs during development phases, including review and assessment of technology options, underground cable routing selection, producing current rating calculations using CYMCAP software and assessment of interface requirements.
* Support the project life cycle, including design development, risk sessions such as HAZIDs, HAZCONs, HAZOPs, construction, installation, commissioning, and completion of complex projects. Collaborate with engineers and managers to identify and mitigate engineering and quality risks, support informed decision\-making, and conduct peer reviews of key issues.
* Develop technical scopes and specifications for new underground cable projects as well as modifications to existing assets.
* Review cable system prequalification and type testing reports in preparation for SSEN approval, reviewing and verifying contractor/consultant detailed underground cable system designs, witnessing factory and relevant discipline site acceptance testing.
* Promote and manage safety within your assigned projects through the implementation of CDM procedures and best practice, ensuring all engineering activities comply with relevant company, HSE and industry regulations.


**You have**


* A degree, HND or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, or significant relevant industry experience. Senior Engineers will ideally be a Chartered Engineer in a relevant institution or working towards chartered status.
* You will have demonstrable experience in transmission development, design and specification, with the ability to evaluate engineering challenges and work with others to identify effective technical solutions.
* To be successful in applying for this role, you will have experience working on the Transmission Network and a strong knowledge of High Voltage Cable systems.
* You will have an awareness of the legal and regulatory obligations for Transmission and be proactive in ensuring these are met to the highest standard. This includes a technical understanding of relevant legislation and the implications of this for Transmission network management for both Assets and Projects, including CDM \& ESQCR, is essential.
* Strong communication skills are essential, with the ability to present complex technical information clearly and concisely to support decision\-making by senior stakeholders. You'll be confident working alongside key stakeholders at all levels, both internally and externally, and building strong, lasting relationships.


We welcome applications from candidates both within and outside the electricity transmission industry. If you have transferable skills and experience from related sectors such as utilities, construction, infrastructure, energy, engineering or Industrial project delivery, we'd love to hear from you.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all.



We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro\-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers.



Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport electricity from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown power for the future and building the infrastructure needed for a cleaner electricity system to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact shirley\-anne.o'connor@sse.com / 01738 351976 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

jobs.description:
**Internal Information**
------------------------


Location: UK Wide


Grade: B2\-C2


SC Clearance Eligibility required


**About the job you're considering**
------------------------------------


You will build and run enterprise\-scale custom software on Azure for clients in regulated and high\-governance sectors. Hands\-on .NET engineering, distributed systems, Kubernetes and the reliability work that keeps them healthy in production, in teams that own what they ship.


We work across Retail, Utilities, Manufacturing, Transport, Health and the Public Sector, so you will pick up new domains quickly and often.


Examples of what you will actually be building


* Application modernisation/re\-platforming a utilities client's billing integration layer from a monolith onto event\-driven .NET microservices on AKS, with no customer\-facing downtime during cutover.
* Designing and running the API platform behind a public sector service handling several million transactions a month, including the service\-level objectives, observability and incident process that go with it.
* Building the internal developer platform and deployment pipelines a retail client's own engineering teams use day to day, so they can release safely without a hand\-off to us.
**Your Role**
-------------


Delivery and technical leadership


* Act as an engineer and subject matter expert on client delivery engagements, owning specification, development, testing and implementation of complex cloud native applications on Azure.
* Lead and mentor development teams and raise the engineering standard around you.
* Shape delivery practice across projects: branching strategy, testing approach, CI/CD and release pipelines.
* Engage credibly with both technical and business stakeholders on the client side.
Engineering


* Design and document Azure cloud native solutions, incorporating recommended security practices, and contribute to architectural decisions.
* Build resilient, scalable APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) and contribute to integration\-led transformations and platforms.
* Containerise workloads with Docker and orchestrate with Azure Kubernetes Service.
* Define and automate infrastructure as code using Bicep or Terraform, and build out CI/CD with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Support services before they go live through design consulting, platform and framework development, automated testing, release pipelines, capacity planning and launch reviews.
* Keep services healthy once live: availability, latency, errors, saturation and traffic, instrumented with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, OpenTelemetry and Log Analytics.
* Apply secure cloud native design principles: identity\-first, encryption, least privilege and zero trust.
* Scale systems sustainably through automation, and reduce toil rather than absorbing it.
**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------


These six things are the bar. If you can evidence them, we want to talk to you.


* Strong production .NET engineering (C\#, .NET 8 or later), with a working command of SOLID, software design patterns and test\-driven development.
* End\-to\-end delivery of Azure PaaS solutions that went live and that you then supported.
* Modernisation of legacy applications to cloud native Azure using AI assisted tooling, e.g. GitHub Copilot
* Containerisation and orchestration in production with Docker and Kubernetes, ideally AKS.
* CI/CD and infrastructure as code in anger: Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and Bicep or Terraform.
* Experience delivering in collaborative agile teams in a commercial, client\-facing environment.
What we will help you build


We use all of the following. You are not expected to arrive with them, and where you do not have them we will help you develop them.


* Domain Driven Design, microservice architecture, CQRS and event sourcing.
* Site reliability practice: service\-level objectives, error budgets, distributed tracing and incident response.
* Identity and access with Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Entra External ID (the successor to Azure AD B2C).
* Security standards including OWASP and PCI DSS.
* Azure AI Services where a product genuinely needs them. Deep agentic AI work sits with our AI Engineering team, and there are routes across if that is where you want to go.
* Data platform and SQL performance work at scale.
**We are a Disability Confident Employer**
------------------------------------------


Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2\) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
  

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:


* Declare they have a disability, and


* Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.


Please opt in during the application process.


**Your security clearance and pre\-employment checks**
------------------------------------------------------


To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.


**Make it real – what does it mean for you?**
---------------------------------------------


We realise a Total Reward package should be more than just compensation. At Capgemini we offer range of core and flexible benefits and have a Peer Recognition Portal called Applaud.


You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024\. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
  

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.


You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.


**Why you should consider Capgemini**
-------------------------------------


Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free\-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

Job Description:

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

About Octopai

Octopai is a fast-growing Data Intelligence company (Acquired by Cloudera) that empowers enterprises to understand, trust, and optimize their data. Our platform provides automated data lineage, cataloging, and discovery to accelerate analytics, improve governance, and drive business impact.

As we expand from SaaS into large-scale enterprise and on-premise deployments, we are investing in strengthening our core platform infrastructure and runtime services
— the foundational layer that powers Octopai’s ingestion, analysis, metadata processing, and operational execution. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help build and evolve these critical platform components.

Role Overview

As a Staff Software Engineer (Core Platform, Runtime Services)
, you will focus on designing and developing the foundational runtime and shared services that enable Octopai’s platform to operate at scale.

This role is deeply technical, centered around building robust infrastructure primitives, runtime orchestration, platform-wide reliability, and performance improvements.

You will work on the systems that sit at the heart of Octopai’s execution engine — supporting metadata harvesting, lineage computation, distributed processing, and enterprise workloads across SaaS and customer-managed deployments.

As a Staff Software Engineer you will:

Design and implement core runtime services that power Octopai’s platform execution, analysis workflows, and operational stability.
Build shared infrastructure components used across the backend organization, including service frameworks, job execution layers, scheduling, and platform abstractions.
Improve scalability, reliability, and performance of platform services supporting metadata ingestion and lineage computation.
Develop platform capabilities for workload orchestration, lifecycle management, retries, fault handling, and resource optimization.
Partner with DevOps and Cloud teams to ensure runtime services are deployable and manageable in Kubernetes-based and enterprise environments.
Build foundations for observability, including logging, metrics, tracing, and troubleshooting tools for core services.
Ensure runtime infrastructure supports enterprise-grade requirements such as isolation, security, compliance, and predictable operations.
Contribute to architecture discussions and evolve Octopai’s core platform foundations through strong design and implementation practices.
Support engineering quality through clean architecture, code reviews, and scalable backend patterns.

We’re excited about you if you have:

8+ years of backend or platform engineering experience, with demonstrated impact at Staff level.
Strong expertise in building scalable backend infrastructure, runtime systems, or distributed service platforms.
Excellent programming skills in C# (.NET), Java and modern backend engineering practices.
Experience designing shared services that support orchestration, execution pipelines, or platform-level abstractions.
Hands-on experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, ArangoDB, or similar).
Familiarity with messaging, caching, and coordination systems (Kafka, Redis, etc.).
Experience operating containerized services and supporting Kubernetes-based deployments.
Strong understanding of production reliability, fault tolerance, observability, and operational best practices.
Ability to work across teams and collaborate effectively with engineering, infrastructure, and product stakeholders.

You may also have:

Experience with workflow engines, distributed job execution systems, or large-scale runtime platforms.
Background supporting hybrid SaaS + enterprise/on-prem deployments.
Familiarity with performance optimization for metadata-heavy or graph-based workloads.
Knowledge of search/index infrastructure (ElasticSearch/Solr) or ingestion pipelines.
Exposure to enterprise compliance, security constraints, and deployment complexity.

About Mozn

MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.

We're a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.

If you're passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.

About the role

We are seeking a talented Software Engineer to join our AI-focused company. In this role, you will design and deliver scalable applications and platforms that power our AI-driven solutions. You will play a key role in building robust systems that integrate data, machine learning, and user interfaces to meet the needs of public and private sector clients in Saudi Arabia.

What you'll do

Developing and maintaining full stack applications with strong front-end and back-end capabilities
Designing user-friendly interfaces and integrate them with AI-powered back-end services
Collaborating with data scientists, ML engineers, and stakeholders to embed AI solutions into software products
Ensuring software systems are secure, scalable, and compliant with local regulations (e.g., PDPL)
Contributing to API development, microservices architecture, and seamless data/model integration
Supporting consultation projects by tailoring software solutions to client requirements
Leading best practices in coding standards, testing, and CI/CD pipelines
Mentoring junior engineers and contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
1+ years of experience in full stack development and solution delivery
Experience working in Saudi Arabia, delivering consultation services to public and private sector clients
Proficiency in modern front-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue, etc) and back-end frameworks (Node.js, Django, etc)
Strong skills in JavaScript/TypeScript, and Python
Knowledge of microservices, APIs, and cloud-native development
Familiarity with AI/ML solution integration is a strong plus
Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD, and containerization

Benefits

You will be at the forefront of an exciting time for the Middle East, joining a high-growth rocket-ship in an exciting space
You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best
The fundamentals will be taken care of: competitive compensation, top-tier health insurance, and an enabling culture so that you can focus on what you do best
You will enjoy a fun and dynamic workplace working alongside some of the greatest minds in AI
We believe strength lies in difference, embracing all for who they are and empowered to be the best version of themselves
